## About
Midway Ford Truck Center is a locally owned Ford dealership in Kansas City, MO, serving customers from Independence, MO to Olathe, KS. We stock new and used Ford trucks and commercial trucks, including work ready trucks that are turn key ready.
The Light Truck Service Center works on gas or diesel pickups, RV's, SUV's, trucks and vans, with Rick Pogulis as light truck service manager. The Medium/Heavy Truck Service Center, run by Bill Davis with assistant manager Brent Davis, repairs all makes and models of medium and heavy trucks, from oil changes to brakes to engine overhauls.
Customers rate us 4.3 from 694 Google reviews.

## Services
- Light Truck Service Center: Repairs and maintenance for gas or diesel pickups, RV's, SUV's, trucks and vans, from oil changes to transmission and engine replacements. Online appointment scheduling is available.
- Medium/Heavy Truck Service Center: Repair for all makes and models of medium and heavy trucks, including Western Star, Thomas Built Buses, Sterling, CAT and Mercedes-Benz.
- Work Ready Trucks: In stock work trucks ready to go: service body and utility body trucks, box vans and box trucks, crane and mechanics trucks, flatbed and gooseneck trucks, and forestry and chipper trucks.
- Ford Protect Extended Service Plan: Additional coverage and programs through PremiumCARE, ExtraCARE, BaseCARE, PowertrainCARE and Diesel Engine Care, tailored to a fleet or a personal vehicle.
- Ford Premium Maintenance Plan: Covers oil and filter changes, multi-point inspections, tire rotations, brake pads and linings, shocks and struts, spark plugs, clutch discs, engine belts and wiper blades.
- Finance Center: Personal and commercial or fleet finance applications for new and used trucks, to buy or lease.
- Public Use DC Fast Charger - Ford Charge: A public use DC fast charger through Ford Charge, alongside our Ford Model e / EV inventory.

## FAQ
Q: Is there a line for heavy truck support after hours?
A: Yes. The heavy truck department has an after hours support line at (816) 413-3333.

Q: Can you pick up and deliver a heavy truck for service?
A: Yes. The heavy truck service department lists pickup and delivery as available.

Q: Who do I talk to about an extended service plan quote?
A: Contact Dan Irwin in our business department at (816)413-3011 for a quote on a Ford Protect plan.

Q: When is the sales showroom open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm. Saturday and Sunday closed.
